description:
I almost didn’t start.

Too afraid to look dumb. 
Too afraid to get hurt. 
Too convinced it was a stupid idea for a 43-year-old to pick up as a hobby.

So I waited. 
And made excuses. 
And watched other people do the thing I actually wanted to do.

Until one day I just… went for it. (And was willing to film myself, which also felt super cringe 😬)

The hardest part wasn’t learning to skate. It wasn’t the falls or the sore knees or figuring out how to stop without looking like a baby deer on ice. 😅

It was deciding I was allowed to try.

That’s it. 
That was the whole battle.

And I think about how many things in my life I’ve almost not started — because I was waiting to feel ready, waiting for permission, waiting until I was sure I wouldn’t fail or look ridiculous.

If you’re in that “I almost didn’t” moment right now — with anything — this is me telling you to go for it.

You don’t need to be ready. You just need to decide you’re allowed.

Follow for more reminders that it’s never too late to believe in yourself. 🛹

#surfskatebeginner #surfskating #confidencecoach #grlswirl #confidencetips
